ns2:course.label: Molecular Marker Data Analyses
ns2:course.description: (CPSC 430) Statistical analyses and interpretation of molecular marker data including development of genetic maps, cluster analyses, quantitative trait loci analyses, and plant breeding applications of molecular marker data. Summer session I in alternate years. Prerequisite: CPSC 440 or equivalent, and CPSC 453 or equivalent. An advanced statistics course (e.g. CPSC 540 or ANSCI 445 or equivalent) and familiarity with SAS recommended.
